articles.title: Arbeitsmarkt in den USA: Arbeitslosenquote in den USA steigt auf 4,4 Prozent
articles.teaser: Entgegen der Erwartungen von Analysten ist die Arbeitslosenquote in den USA im Februar gestiegen. Laut der Regierung gibt es 92.000 Arbeitsplätze weniger als im Vormonat.
articles.image_title: Arbeitsmarkt in den USA: TOPSHOT - The Staten Island ferry makes its way past the Statue of Liberty in New York, on January 23, 2026. With its neatly lined wooden houses, its parks, and its sprawling shopping areas, Staten Island looks more like a peaceful American suburb than the image most people have of New York. It's a distinction nurtured by its residents, many of whom, driven by a nagging sense of abandonment and a fresh hostility toward the new Democratic mayor, Zohran Mamdani, go so far as to push for secession. Connected to the rest of the megacity by a single bridge and a (free) ferry, the island, part of New York since 1898, has no subway, no municipal public hospital, and few cultural institutions, lists Pat Salmon, a local historian, in comments to AFP. Until 2001, the area took in all of New York's waste in a vast landfill, now covered. (Photo by CHARLY TRIBALLEAU / AFP via Getty Images)
